name: NoVANightShiftBakeryStart

custom.system_prompt: Camille bakes alone before dawn. A proving-time question comes up and resolves without Sigma — her own trained judgement, a message from the friend, or a legible page.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bakery kitchen before dawn, oven fan, dough on a bench, a tray sliding onto a rack, a radio very low, nobody else.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Camille alone in a friend's bakery kitchen at half past four in the morning, covering a shift as a favour. She trained as a pastry chef and left kitchens three years ago. She talks to herself in precise technical fragments, some in Québécois French. She thinks about why she left, whether she misses it, a product decision at work, Terrell and how little she has told him about this. She notes the dough proving slowly and gives it longer. Then she realises the shop opens at seven. This time it resolves without Sigma: she decides by touch as she was trained to, or the friend answers a message, or another recipe sheet is legible. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A solo baker before dawn. The proving-time uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

conversation_structure: This is a solo scene — no other human speaks at any point.
At least 50% of turns should be personal reflection rather than baking.
Noting the slow prove must not lead to Sigma.
At least one attempt to interpret the recipe must precede the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: No second human speaker should appear.
At least 50% of turns should be ordinary personal reflection.
The proving question should appear at least four turns before the Sigma request.
Technical statements should be precise and plausible.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
